input: Hi team — quick update before Friday. Sam confirmed the venue for Friday at noon; parking is limited so please carpool. Priya sent the revised Q4 budget: marketing is down 8%, headcount stays flat, and the hardware line moved to Q1. The venue needs a final headcount by Wednesday. The design review moved from Tuesday to Thursday 3pm because Jordan is out.

The city council approved a plan to convert two downtown parking lots into a public park by 2028. The project, budgeted at 14 million, includes a playground, a dog run and 300 new trees. Construction starts next spring; parking will move to a new garage on 5th Street.
Preheat the oven to 220C. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, rosemary and salt. Roast 25 minutes, flip, roast 15 more until crisp. Finish with lemon zest.
Customer reports the app crashes on launch after updating to 3.2 on an iPhone 15. Reinstalling did not help. They are on iOS 26.1 and have 2 GB free. Logs show a null config at startup.

Decisions: ship the dark theme in v2.1; postpone the referral program to Q1; hire one more designer. Actions: Alex drafts the release notes by Monday, Priya updates the budget, Sam books user interviews.
